reference.question: Given \(f(x)=x^3-3x\), what is the positive value of \(x\) for which \(f'(x)=0\)?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Differentiate and take square roots

\(3x^2-3=0\), so \(x^2=1\). The positive root is \(1\).
